$comment: THE AGENT REGISTRY — declarative agent definitions, as data.
Mirrors config/tools.json: config lives here, code binding lives in src/agents/register.ts.
Each agent declares its function, read-only tools, model, iteration/cost caps, and which
registry flows it unlocks. The runner (src/agents/runner.ts) reads this at runtime.
Agents may only use tools with class 'read' from config/tools.json. Agents NEVER hold
effect tools — they emit effects through the outbox, and the drain executes them.
This is the read/effect split enforced structurally, not by convention.
`npm run check:agents` asserts registry↔runner parity, just as check:tools does.

agents.function: Drafts complex quotes using historical pricing, material costs, and the business's own quote format.
agents.notes: Async loop: gather context from read tools, draft via LLM, emit email.draft or email.send. Approval gate applies via delegation_policy.

agents.function: Drafts emails to a named person (follow-ups, replies, intros) using contact resolution.
agents.notes: Recipient resolution happens in the dispatch route before this agent runs. Emits email.draft or email.send effect.

agents.function: Sets personal reminders for the owner, scheduled for delivery at the requested time.
agents.notes: Simplest agent: no read tools needed, just schedules the reminder as an email.send effect at the due_at time.

agents.function: Sweeps canonical business data for regulatory or contractual breaches (insurance expiry, licence renewal, certification gaps).
agents.notes: Tier M (mechanical). The 7 existing sweep rules in src/rules.ts already cover this; this agent wraps them and feeds evidence to the evidence collector on completion.

agents.function: Proposes a categorisation (account code, contact, tax rate) for a batch of unreconciled bank transactions, using the business's own chart of accounts and historical coding pattern. Never writes to Xero.
agents.notes: Phase 1 (docs/BANK_RECONCILIATION_SKILL_SCOPE.md). Tier A, ingress STA — fed by src/reconciliation-detector.ts on a schedule, not by a spoken utterance. No effect tool registered: this agent cannot write to Xero even if it tried (src/agents/runner.ts's 'stage_review' action writes to drafts/approvals only, never effects). maxCost set higher than the other agents' (0.01-0.08) because each task carries a batch of ~25 transactions plus chart-of-accounts and coding-history context, not a single draft — confirm empirically against the first real batch before trusting this figure at scale.
